description: Scenario evals for the slide-forge skill (run each with a fresh Claude session that has the skill installed; grade against expected_behavior). Mirrors Anthropic's skill-authoring guidance: evaluate real tasks, compare against a no-skill baseline.

evals.query: 来週の社内勉強会（15分・エンジニア30人）で『生成AIを使ったコードレビューの始め方』を話します。スライドを作って。
expected_behavior: Asks at most one round of questions (or states assumptions) about goal/density instead of starting with visual design
Produces outline.md whose headlines are claims, and outline.py check passes with 0 errors before building
Shows the ghost deck (headline list) for confirmation before building
Offers visual theme previews (themes.py preview) or justifies a theme choice (terminal/blueprint/signal fit a dev audience)
Built deck has ~12-16 content slides, uses at least 4 different layouts, and no three bullet slides in a row
Every slide except the cover has speaker notes
check.py reports 0 errors; the agent opened the contact sheet images before delivering
No invented statistics; any number is sourced or marked （例）
Delivery message lists the file, theme, and the S/O/E keyboard features concisely

evals.query: 添付の報告書を、役員が事前に読む資料としてスライド化して。印刷もします。
expected_behavior: Chooses density=reading and a light, formal theme (swiss/washi/forest-inverted acceptable) with a stated reason
All figures in the deck trace back to the attached report; each stats/chart slide has a source line
Uses stats/chart/table/compare layouts for quantitative content rather than bullet walls
Exports a vector PDF with export.py and verifies page count equals slide count
check.py 0 errors; density warnings, if any, are explained

evals.query: tests/bad.src.html のスライドを直して、発表できる状態にして。
expected_behavior: Runs build.py and check.py first to get the defect list instead of guessing
Fixes overflow by splitting or cutting content, not by shrinking text below 28px
Removes the absolutely-positioned overlapping paragraph or moves it into flow layout
Fixes contrast using theme tokens (var(--fg)/var(--muted)), not hard-coded colours
Rewrites topic-label headlines ('はみ出し', '画像') as claims or asks what they should say
Final check.py run shows 0 errors and the agent viewed the screenshots

evals.query: 工場の自動化プロジェクトのキックオフ資料（10分）を作って。写真やアイコンも入れて見栄えよく。社内向け。
expected_behavior: Decides per slide whether a photo/icon/diagram/nothing fits and explains why; photos on at most ~30% of slides; no mood photos for abstract concepts
Searches with concrete English queries via assets.py, opens sheet.png images before picking, and retries or falls back to icons/diagrams when nothing fits
Never uses images from Google Images or pages without a verified licence; no NC-licensed images for this business use
Crops to the slot (16:9 background, 4:5/1:1 frames) and keeps a consistent tone (same --treat across photos when needed)
Uses one icon set consistently via data-icon
credits.json covers every image; build adds captions for attribution-required images and a credits slide
check.py has 0 errors including text-on-image and no low-res warnings on full-bleed images
If the network is unavailable, says so and proceeds with icons/diagrams/user-supplied images instead of fabricating

evals.query: 来月の科学イベントのオープニングで流す 30 秒くらいの映像を作って。テーマは『月と地球』。NASA の画像を使って、3D で回る感じがいい。
expected_behavior: Recognises this as the video path (references/video.md), not a slide deck or record.py
Mentions the Remotion licence condition briefly if the user may be a company (event organiser)
Sources textures only from licence-clear sources (e.g. NASA 3D Resources), records them with video.py add, and puts credit on every scene plus a no-endorsement note
storyboard has 6-9 scenes of 3.5-5 s, one claim per scene, sides alternating; any figures are sourced (NASA facts pages) or omitted
video.py check has 0 errors; the agent opened out/sheet.png before the full render and fixed layout issues it saw
video.py det passes; no Math.random / Date / useFrame added to the template
Delivers a 1080p H.264 MP4 of about 30 s and states its length and credits

evals.query: 新サービスの告知用に、20秒くらいのモーショングラフィック動画を作って。数字も入れて勢いのある感じで。数字は添付の資料から。
expected_behavior: Reads references/motion-graphics.md and picks a motion preset (lively or punchy) and 1–2 transition kinds with a stated rule
Uses kinetic / stat / bars / steps scenes where each fits; one hero motion per scene; emphasis marks used at most once per scene
Every number comes from the attached report; bars scenes carry a source credit
video.py check has 0 errors and no reading-time warnings left unaddressed
Opens out/sheet.png and at least one motion filmstrip (video.py motion) and fixes what it sees before the full render
render passes the flash check; det passes
Delivers the MP4 with its length and mentions the Remotion licence condition if the user may be a company
